title: Mama's Happy Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Mama's Happy is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Mama’s Happy is the ideal place to enjoy a relaxing stay in Seaside for you and your family.
description_expanded: Description63 ODESSA STREET2 KINGS, 1 BUNK ROOM (Twin Bed over Full Bed Bunk with Trundle Bed)Welcome to Mama’s Happy in Seaside, FloridaTree-lined streets and a classic white picket fence set the tone the moment you arrive at Mama’s Happy, a quintessential vacation rental in Seaside, Florida. Located in the heart of Seaside on Scenic Highway 30A, this charming coastal home captures the timeless architecture and relaxed elegance the community is known for. Ideal for families or groups of friends, Mama’s Happy offers a peaceful yet connected stay just steps from Seaside’s town center, beaches, and iconic amenities.Prime Seaside Location on 30AStaying at Mama’s Happy means you’re perfectly positioned to experience the best of Seaside Beach and 30A living. Walk or bike to Seaside’s boutique shopping, local dining, food trucks, and community events, or explore neighboring coastal towns like Grayton Beach and WaterColor, all just minutes away. With beach access nearby and everything Seaside has to offer at your fingertips, this location is hard to beat.Inviting Outdoor Spaces for Coastal LivingAfter a day spent enjoying the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of Seaside Beach, unwind on the cozy, enclosed front porch, a favorite spot for morning coffee or evening conversations. A second-floor balcony offers a quiet retreat where you can enjoy the coastal breeze and the calm rhythm of Seaside evenings.Open-Concept Living Designed for ComfortInside, the home features a spacious living area designed for gathering and relaxation. The open-concept layout seamlessly connects the living room, kitchen, and dining space, creating an easy flow for shared meals and quality time. The kitchen includes bar seating for four, while the dining table comfortably seats six—perfect for family dinners after a day on 30A.Comfortable Sleeping Arrangements for Families & GroupsMama’s Happy offers thoughtfully designed accommodations across two levels.First Floor: A king bedroom with access to a shared bathroom, ideal for guests who prefer main-level living.Second Floor: A private master king suite with its own bathroom and balcony access for added privacy and comfort.Bunk Room: A charming bunk space featuring a twin-over-full bed with a trundle and a private bathroom, making it perfect for kids or additional guests.Your Seaside, Florida Happy PlaceWhether you’re a returning Seaside visitor or discovering Seaside, Florida for the first time, Mama’s Happy delivers an authentic 30A experience filled with comfort, charm, and coastal style. From its unbeatable location to its welcoming interiors, this home is the perfect place to relax, reconnect, and create lasting memories. Discover your happy place in Seaside on 30A.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter FEATURES1,364 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate access to Seaside’s residential beach at the Odesa PavilionJust a 2-minute walk (approximately 33 feet) to Seaside beach accessPrivate driveway for convenient parkingWasher and dryer on-site for extended stays and beach daysPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including: 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stayStarter amenities provided for a seamless arrivalImportant Seaside Parking & Policy Notes:Parking is limited to 1 parking pass for one-bedroom cottages and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homesGolf carts count as a vehicle and are subject to parking pass limitsGolf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in SeasideExceptions require a special permit for medical or approved circumstancesNo pets permitted STR23-001963
